if: the document is a refund voucher referred to in clause (e) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 51 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the refund voucher MUST describe the goods or services the refund relates to
note: One mandatory particular of rule 51(f), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: description of goods or services in respect of which refund is made;
